title: SFST: One Leg Stand
citation: NHTSA SFST procedures form, published by NJ Division of Highway Traffic Safety
key_points: Subject raises either foot about six inches, toe pointed, legs straight, looks at the raised foot and counts aloud by thousands until told to stop.
Four clues: swaying; raising arms for balance; hopping; putting the foot down.
officer_notes: Record which foot was raised and when each clue occurred.
